snippet.title: Tales of Seikyu Release Date Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: A peaceful farming life sim set on the island of Seikyu. Grow your farm, restore your ancestral home, form heartfelt bonds with villagers, and shapeshift into different spirit forms to explore a world that moves gently with the seasons. 1.0 releases on June 11, 2026 and includes a conclusion to the main story with Chapter 3, the new fox yokai transformation, three new romanceable villagers, a marriage system, new festivals and much much more! https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
